item.title: Ho Chi Minh City braces for motorcycle emissions inspections
item.description: The Ho Chi Minh City Department of Construction has instructed vehicle registration and inspection centers to prepare facilities and equipment for motorcycle emissions testing.

item.title: Singapore's ST Engineering showcases cargo drone, marine craft as it expands reach
item.description: SINGAPORE - ST Engineering is showing off two distinct platforms at the Singapore Airshow that mark a significant expansion into next-generation aviation technologies for the world's largest airframe maintenance and repair services provider.

item.title: Dozens hospitalized in Ho Chi Minh City after year-end party
item.description: Dozens of people in Ho Chi Minh City were rushed to hospital for emergency treatment after developing symptoms consistent with food poisoning following a year-end party held a few days ago.

item.title: Paris cybercrime unit searches X office; Musk summoned
item.description: PARIS -- French police raided the offices of Elon Musk's social media network X on Tuesday and prosecutors ordered the tech billionaire to face questions in a widening investigation, amid growing scrutiny of the platform by authorities across Europe.

item.title: Vietnam’s Dak Lak suspends tourism at 3 waterfalls for safety
item.description: Authorities in Dak Lak Province, central Vietnam have suspended visitor access to three major waterfalls during the Lunar New Year holiday to ensure public safety, citing inadequate infrastructure and emergency preparedness.

item.title: Teen swims four hours to save family lost at sea off Australia
item.description: A 13-year-old boy recounted on Tuesday how he swam for four hours through choppy waters off Western Australia to get help for his family in a feat hailed by rescuers as "superhuman".

item.title: Australia warns $3.2 trillion pension fund industry to lift systems investment
item.description: SYDNEY -- Australia's corporate regulator has warned the nation's A$4.5 trillion ($3.16 trillion) pension fund industry it needs to invest more in systems and technology to better prepare for the future and avoid becoming troubled like stock market operator ASX (ASX.AX).

item.title: Vietnamese health ministry proposes ban on smoking in indoor spaces
item.description: Vietnam’s Ministry of Health has proposed a sweeping ban on smoking in all indoor spaces, public places, and educational institutions, while suggesting the permission of smoking only in clearly designated locations that meet strict standards.

item.title: Vietnam’s Khanh Hoa receives 9 cruise ship calls in early 2026
item.description: Khanh Hoa Province in south-central Vietnam has received nine international cruise ship calls since the start of the year, bringing thousands of foreign tourists ashore and signaling a recovery in cruise tourism, local authorities said.

item.description: The shared future of Asia and Japan
